name: Thomas Yoon
bio: Thomas has worked as an iOS Engineer at Tinder past 3 years. His recent projects include SuperBoost and upgrading Tinder Gold experiences. He is a core member of Tinder's revenue team that achieved top grossing app in the app store, driving millions of dollars each month. Previously, he has worked on Tinder Places with many location tracking technologies and beautiful animations, introduced Tinder Feed, revamped chat experience, and incorporated Spotify to Tinder profiles. He is passionate about creating the most aesthetically pleasing user experiences and building tools for the team members.
